name: node_embedding_similarity
author: 41c8e8e2
description: Finds the nodes that play the most similar structural role to a given node, using DeepWalk-style random-walk embeddings: random walks from every node are turned into co-occurrence statistics, factorised into low-dimensional vectors, and nodes are ranked by cosine similarity to the query node. Use it for questions like 'which nodes are most like X?' or 'which airports play a similar role to Chennai?'. Edge direction and weights are ignored. Randomness is controlled by a seed (default 0), so results are repeatable. Returns the top_k most similar nodes with cosine scores.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse, e.g. 'karate'.

node.description: Id of the query node to find look-alikes for. Use lookup_node to find an id from a name.

top_k.description: How many similar nodes to return.

dimensions.description: Size of each embedding vector (1 to 128).

num_walks.description: Random walks started from every node (1 to 50).

window.description: How many steps apart two nodes on a walk still count as co-occurring (1 to 20).

seed.description: Random seed; the same seed always gives the same answer.
